backend/main.mo: Includes MixinStorage to enable storage features on the backend actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a header auto-hide feature to its related frontend file, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for various frontend components and styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that sets up the root element and loads the main React entry script.
frontend/src/.well-known/ic-domains: Specifies the verified domain shivaritaglobal.com for IC deployment.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Creates and provides a TanStack Router instance for the application.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders a detailed About Us section with company mission, expertise, and service highlights.
Displays service categories and visa type links with icons and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Implements a contact form with validation, email/WhatsApp integration, and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/CountrySlideshow: Auto-playing slideshow of European destinations with navigation controls and click-to-contact behavior.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimerSectio: Renders a detailed disclaimer section with multiple informational blocks about visa limitations, accuracy, legal changes, and other notices.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with company info, navigation links, social links, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/GDPRSection.tsx: Shows GDPR compliance details, principles, and explanatory text about data protection practices.
frontend/src/components/GlobeSection.tsx: Empty or placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a responsive, auto-hiding header with navigation links and mobile menu behavior based on scroll state.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Provides the homepage hero section with headline, CTAs, stats, and decorative background elements.
frontend/src/components/InteractiveGlobe: Empty or placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/MapSection.tsx: Displays a world map with a clickable overlay that navigates users to the contact page for visa inquiries.
React component displaying immigration product offerings with tabs, accordions, and deep-link handling for sections.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Shows key consulting advantages and ancillary services using cards, icons, and descriptive sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React hook that initializes and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, storage, and state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook indicating no backend queries are needed for the static site.
frontend/src/ic-assets.json: Specifies that .well-known assets should be included in the build.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark themes, variables, and base styling for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React, query client, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Page component that renders the About section.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Page component that displays the Contact section.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Page component rendering the Disclaimer section.
frontend/src/pages/GDPRPage.tsx: Page component displaying the GDPR section.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page assembling hero, map, slideshow, and category sections.
Page wrapper for the ProductOffering component.
frontend/src/pages/WhyChooseUsPage.tsx: Page wrapper rendering the WhyChooseUs component.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the router structure, routes, and root layout using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash-based), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, layout, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state and feature requests, mainly describing work on auto-hiding and revealing the site header based on scroll and hover behavior.
